display.purpose: Hero headlines, section titles, the wordmark. Fraunces only.

body.purpose: Paragraph copy, nav links, form labels. Poppins.

label.purpose: The blueprint-annotation layer: eyebrows, specs, prices, badges, counters. IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, wide-tracked.

motion.name: kenburns
motion.purpose: Slow zoom-out on full-bleed hero background images; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: reveal
motion.value: opacity 0->1, translateY(20px)->0; 0.8s ease-out, staggered 80-150ms per sibling
motion.purpose: Scroll-triggered content reveal via IntersectionObserver at 15% visibility, fires once; disabled under prefers-reduced-motion.

motion.name: tick-rule-draw
motion.value: transform: scaleX(0) -> scaleX(1), transform-origin left; 1s cubic-bezier(0.65,0,0.35,1)
motion.purpose: Draw-in animation for the signature tick-rule divider motif when scrolled into view.

motion.name: nav-underline-draw
motion.value: transform: scaleX(0) -> scaleX(1), transform-origin left; 0.35s ease-out
motion.purpose: Active nav link's gold underline drawing in.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Filled gold CTA; hover inverts fill to ink.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #b07b1f; color: #f6f4ef; padding: 12px 32px; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; border: none; transition: background-color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #17181a; } .ds-btn-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Gold-outlined CTA that fills solid gold on hover; the site's most common button.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { display: inline-block; background: transparent; color: #b07b1f; border: 1px solid #b07b1f; padding: 12px 32px; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; transition: background-color 0.2s, color 0.2s; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: #b07b1f; color: #17181a; }

components.name: Status Badge — Coming Soon
components.description: Solid gold-fill mono badge for a 'Brevemente' property; the available state renders no badge at all.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-block; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; padding: 6px 12px; } .ds-badge-gold { background: #b07b1f; color: #17181a; }

components.name: Status Badge — Reserved
components.description: Solid rust-fill mono badge for a 'Reservado' property.
components.css: .ds-badge-rust { background: #9c4a3c; color: #f6f4ef; font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; font-size: 11px; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 0.15em; padding: 6px 12px; }

components.name: Property Card
components.description: Signature listing card: full-bleed image with kenburns-style crop, bottom scrim, tick-rule above the address, mono price/specs. No border-radius, no shadow.
components.html:
Rua das Flores, Lisboa
450 000 €
components.css: .ds-card { position: relative; display: block; overflow: hidden; background: #292c2f; aspect-ratio: 3/4; } .ds-card-img { position: absolute; inset: 0; width: 100%; height: 100%; object-fit: cover; transition: transform 0.7s ease-out; } .ds-card:hover .ds-card-img { transform: scale(1.05); } .ds-card-scrim { position: absolute; inset: 0; background: linear-gradient(to top, rgba(23,24,26,0.9), rgba(23,24,26,0.1) 60%, transparent); } .ds-card-body { position: absolute; inset-inline: 0; bottom: 0; padding: 24px; } .ds-tick-rule { position: relative; height: 1px; background: #b07b1f; opacity: 0.8; margin-bottom: 16px; } .ds-tick-rule::before, .ds-tick-rule::after { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -3px; width: 1px; height: 7px; background: #b07b1f; } .ds-tick-rule::before { left: 0; } .ds-tick-rule::after { right: 0; } .ds-card-address { font-family: Fraunces, Georgia, serif; color: #f6f4ef; font-size: 20px; line-height: 1.3; } .ds-card-price { font-family: 'IBM Plex Mono', monospace; color: #d9b673; font-size: 13px; margin-top: 4px; }

components.name: Text Input
components.description: Bottom-line-only field; focus shifts the underline to solid gold. No box, no ring.
components.css: .ds-input { background: transparent; border: none; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(23,24,26,0.2); padding: 8px 0; font-size: 14px; font-family: Poppins, sans-serif; width: 100%; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: #8c877e; } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #b07b1f; }

components.name: Primary Navigation
components.description: Fixed header; transparent over the hero, translucent charcoal-blur once scrolled. Active link gets a gold color and an animated underline.
components.html: InícioSobreImóveis
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; gap: 40px; align-items: center; } .ds-nav-link { position: relative; display: inline-block; padding: 8px 0; font-size: 14px; letter-spacing: 0.02em; color: rgba(246,244,239,0.9); transition: color 0.2s; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-link:hover { color: #b07b1f; } .ds-nav-link-active { color: #b07b1f; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-link-active::after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 0; right: 0; bottom: -1px; height: 1px; background: #b07b1f; }

narrative.overview:
The system reads as an architect's drafting table crossed with a ledger book: warm, precise, and quietly confident, never decorative for its own sake. It carries Magda Leal's dual identity — twenty years reading buildings as a civil engineer, ten years reading the market as a consultant — into every surface. A single warm gold marks what matters; everything else sits in flat, tonal planes of ink, charcoal, and paper, joined by hairline rules rather than shadows.

The system rejects rounded, soft, "app-like" UI conventions (bubble buttons, card shadows, colorful chips) in favor of hard-cornered rectangles, mono-spaced "dimension line" annotations, and a serif display face for moments that need weight. Depth comes from translucency and tonal contrast, never elevation.
keyCharacteristics: Flat planes, hard corners, hairline dividers — no shadows anywhere.
One accent color (gold) used sparingly and consistently for interaction and emphasis.
A recurring "blueprint annotation" language (mono, uppercase, wide-tracked) for data: prices, specs, eyebrows, captions, counters.
Precise and restrained component personality — the gold accent and typography carry the energy, not ornament.

rules.name: The Absence-as-Status Rule
rules.body: An available property carries no badge at all — the absence of a badge is the "Disponível" signal. Badges exist only to flag an exception (coming soon = gold fill, reserved = rust fill). Never add a neutral/default badge for the available state.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: Gold is the only color that ever signals interactivity or emphasis. Don't introduce a second "brand" hue for hover states, links, or highlights — invert to ink/charcoal instead.

rules.name: The Mono-Means-Data Rule
rules.body: Any numeral or short label that describes the thing itself — a price, a spec, a status, a counter, an eyebrow — is set in IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, wide-tracked. Fraunces and Poppins never carry numerals of this kind.

rules.name: The No-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Never add box-shadow anywhere in this system. If something needs to feel "above" the page, darken what's behind it or add a hairline border instead.

rules.name: The Sharp Corner Rule
rules.body: Radius is the exception, not the default. Reach for rounded-sm only for a confirmation/success moment — never for cards, images, buttons, or badges.

rules.name: The Sparse Tick Rule
rules.body: The tick-rule motif marks a deliberate technical flourish — it is not a general-purpose divider. Everyday section separation uses a plain border-t hairline at 10% opacity instead.

rules.name: The Background-Matched Gold Rule
rules.body: Small mono/uppercase text (eyebrows, labels) never uses base Instrument Gold directly on a flat surface — neither charcoal nor paper gives it AA contrast at that size. Use Soft Brass on charcoal, Deep Gold on paper.

dos: Do keep gold as the only accent color that signals interactivity — invert to ink/charcoal for hover/active states instead of introducing a second hue.
Do set any price, spec, status, counter, or eyebrow label in IBM Plex Mono, uppercase, wide letter-spacing.
Do match the gold variant to its background for small text (Soft Brass on charcoal, Deep Gold on paper).
Do keep corners sharp by default; reach for rounded-sm only for a confirmation/success moment.
Do convey depth with flat tonal contrast, translucency, and hairline borders — never a box-shadow.
Do use the tick-rule motif sparingly, only at moments meant to feel like a deliberate technical flourish.
Do keep filter/search state mirrored in the URL and give every empty or failed state a concrete recovery action.
donts: Don't add drop shadows, card elevation, or glow effects anywhere — it breaks the flat "blueprint" language.
Don't give the "Disponível" (available) status its own badge — its signal is the absence of one.
Don't use default Tailwind red (text-red-700) for error states — use Reserved Rust instead.
Don't set base Instrument Gold directly as small text color on a flat charcoal or paper surface — it fails AA contrast at that size either way.
Don't round buttons, cards, images, or badges — sharp corners are the system's default, not an oversight to "fix."
Don't use the tick-rule as a general section divider — plain low-opacity hairline borders handle everyday separation.
